pit_lane_transit_time.description: Duration between pit-entry loop (PitInTime) and pit-exit loop (PitOutTime)

total_pit_loss.description: Total race time lost relative to continuing at racing speed: (InLapTime + OutLapTime) - 2 * LocalRefPace

stationary_service_time.justification: FastF1 and FIA live timing do not log stationary wheel-on/wheel-off micro-timestamps in standard public feeds. PitOutTime - PitInTime measures total pit-lane transit (~22.4s). Subtracting the 370m pit lane transit at 80 km/h (~16.7s) and acceleration/deceleration margins (~2.5s) yields an inferred stationary stop time of 2.5–3.2s.
